summary.text: Squires stated that the future of intellectual property cannot be discussed without AI, and he described IP protection in fields such as AI as an essential national-security function. He described USPTO efforts to use AI in patent examination, including human-in-the-loop systems, a pilot that sends AI-generated prior art to applicants early, and expanded AI tools intended to improve efficiency and quality. He said the USPTO opened an Emerging Technologies Office in San Francisco to advance AI use, engage with the AI industry, and help U.S. companies export AI products and systems.

This conclusion is limited to the supplied excerpts; no additional source context was supplied.
